TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: This lookup returns UDC columns Key, Code, Desc1and Desc2 from User defined tables. If you have column UDC value "01/03" then Pass "01" to UDC_TYPE_CODE1 and "02" to UDC_TYPE_CODE2
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: LKP_UDC_DIM

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT USER_DEFINED_CODE_DIM.UDC_KEY AS UDC_KEY, USER_DEFINED_CODE_DIM.UDC_CODE AS UDC_CODE , USER_DEFINED_CODE_DIM.UDC_DESC1 AS UDC_DESC1, USER_DEFINED_CODE_DIM.UDC_DESC2 AS UDC_DESC2, USER_DEFINED_CODE_TYPE.UDC_PRODUCT_CODE AS UDC_PRODUCT_CODE, USER_DEFINED_CODE_TYPE.UDC_CODES AS UDC_CODES FROM USER_DEFINED_CODE_DIM , USER_DEFINED_CODE_TYPE WHERE USER_DEFINED_CODE_DIM.UDC_TYPE_KEY=USER_DEFINED_CODE_TYPE.UDC_TYPE_KEY

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup condition
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: UDC_CODE = i_UDC_CODE AND UDC_PRODUCT_CODE = i_UDC_TYPE_CODE1 AND UDC_CODES = i_UDC_TYPE_CODE2

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION:
Get User Defined Code's KEY, DESC1 and DESC2 for JDE UDC_TYPE CODES.
Usage: ======= 1. If you column have UDC "01/02" then pass "01" to UDC_TYPE CODE1 and "02" to UDC_TYPE CODE2. Please make sure you are passing Value before "/" to UDC_TYPE CODE1. 2. Pass Code column value to UDC_CODE

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Sql Query
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT F0101.ABAN8, F0101.ABALKY, F0101.ABTAX, F0101.ABALPH, F0101.ABMCU, F0101.ABSIC, F0101.ABAT1, F0101.ABAN81, F0101.ABAN82, F0101.ABAN83, F0101.ABAN84, F0101.ABAN86, F0101.ABAC01, F0101.ABAC02, F0101.ABAC03, F0101.ABAC04, F0101.ABAC05, F0101.ABAC06, F0101.ABAC07, F0101.ABAC08, F0101.ABAC09, F0101.ABAC10, F0101.ABAC11, F0101.ABAC12, F0101.ABAC13, F0101.ABAC14, F0101.ABAC15, F0101.ABAC16, F0101.ABAC17, F0101.ABAC18, F0101.ABAC19, F0101.ABAC20, F0101.ABAC21, F0101.ABAC22, F0101.ABAC23, F0101.ABAC24, F0101.ABAC25, F0101.ABAC26, F0101.ABAC27, F0101.ABAC28, F0101.ABAC29, F0101.ABAC30, F0101.ABRMK, F0101.ABURDT, F0101.ABUPMJ, F0101.ABUPMT, F03012.AICRCD, F03012.AIACL, F03012.AITRAR, F03012.AIDNLT, F03012.AICMGR, F03012.AICLMG, F03012.AIDLQT, F03012.AIDB, F03012.AICRCA, F03012.AIDAOJ, F03012.AICPGP, F0150.MAPA8, F0116.ALADDS, F0116.ALCTR, F03012.AITXA1, F03012.AIEXR1, F03012.AICARS, F03012.AIDEL1, F03012.AIDEL2, F03012.AIFRTH, F03012.AIPRIO FROM $$ParamJDEDATASchema.F0101 F0101 LEFT OUTER JOIN $$ParamJDEDATASchema.F03012 F03012 ON F0101.ABAN8 = F03012.AIAN8 AND F03012.AICO = '00000' LEFT OUTER JOIN $$ParamJDEDATASchema.F0150 F0150 ON F0101.ABAN8 = F0150.MAAN8 LEFT OUTER JOIN $$ParamJDEDATASchema.F0101 F0101_1 ON F0150.MAPA8 = F0101_1.ABAN8 INNER JOIN $$ParamJDEDATASchema.F0116 F0116 ON F0101.ABAN8 = F0116.ALAN8 INNER JOIN (SELECT ALAN8, MAX(ALEFTB) AS ALEFTB FROM $$ParamJDEDATASchema.F0116 WHERE ALEFTB <= TO_JULIAN(SYSDATE) GROUP BY ALAN8 ) F0116E ON F0116.ALAN8 = F0116E.ALAN8 AND F0116.ALEFTB = F0116E.ALEFTB WHERE ( (F0101.ABUPMJ >$$FROM_JDE_DATE) OR ((F0101.ABUPMJ=$$FROM_JDE_DATE) AND ( F0101.ABUPMT >$$FROM_JDE_TIME)))
